knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Any jet contact is a medical emergency because the surface wound can understate the injury, and the material carried may be contaminated. The WorkSafe Victoria alert gives no first-aid step, so urgent medical attention is a course precaution. The learner stops the equipment and seeks urgent medical attention, and tells the medical team about the jet.
Pressure is isolated and released as the manufacturer directs before any clearance. Clearing a nozzle by hand under pressure, or raising the pressure, is never the response.
The WorkSafe Victoria alert states the operator in control of the water flow wears at least safety glasses and a face shield (read 2026-11-02).
A breach of the exclusion zone means the jet stops at once and the zone is held. Warning verbally while the jet runs, or raising the pressure, leaves the person in the spray path.

The lesson states that it grants no licence, certificate, competency or authority to operate Class B or industrial equipment. Competency comes through an RTO assessment, which this lesson does not provide.

practicalCriteria: Before starting, the learner sets an exclusion zone and confirms with the site controller who holds it.
The learner checks the PPE for the task and confirms the operator in control of the water flow wears at least safety glasses and a face shield.
The learner inspects each hose, fitting and coupling for damage and confirms each is rated at or above the maximum operating pressure.
The learner stops the equipment immediately when a person enters the zone, and isolates and releases pressure before any adjustment.
The learner records the zone, the PPE check and the inspection on the job record.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% correct (4 of 5). Practical sign-off is assessed separately by observation on a supervised routine task that does not use high-pressure jetting beyond what the assessor authorises. Competency for Class B equipment is not assessed here.
evidenceRequired: Exclusion zone record with the person who holds it
Hose, fitting and coupling inspection record with the rated pressure
Incident record for any jet contact or hose failure, if one occurred
stopWorkCriteria: A person enters the spray line or exclusion zone while the jet runs.
A hose, fitting or coupling is damaged, not rated for the pressure, or moves unexpectedly.
The learner checks a nozzle or blockage by hand while the equipment is pressurised.
An unapproved attachment is fitted or the operator lacks the required PPE.
